q: Will a green loan get my MSME a lower interest rate in India?
title: Do green loans carry lower rates?
short: Sometimes, not always. Some banks offer small concessions for green projects, and renewable energy loans can count toward priority sector lending, which helps banks lend. The rate still depends mostly on your credit profile. Treat any saving as possible, not promised.
audience: MSME owners comparing green and ordinary term loans

ul: Bank or SIDBI schemes for energy efficiency and renewable energy.
Priority sector treatment for eligible renewable energy loans.
Credit guarantee schemes that reduce the collateral needed.
Your repayment history, cash flow and collateral.
The bank's benchmark rate and spread.
Project quality: a clear report with realistic savings.

p: Look at processing fees, any external review costs and reporting effort, not only the headline rate.

senseible: Senseible turns invoices and bills into dated, fingerprinted emission records, the evidence a lender usually asks to see first.
